app.title: Ridgeback Rangers
build.help: An empty spot for a new paddock. More paddocks = more room for animals.
buy.cafe1.d: Visitors spend more after the tour.
buy.cooler.d: Crates never spoil in the heat. +8 crate space.
buy.feed_run2.d: The feed truck tops up every station at 13:00.
buy.fence2.d: Lasts twice as long. Bossy animals need it.
buy.fence3.d: The strongest fence. Almost never comes loose.
buy.hatch_tech.d: Keeps every egg at the right temperature by itself.
buy.incubator.d: Warm one more egg at a time.
buy.shade.d: Keeps animals cool in a heat wave.
buy.tram_car.d: +16 seats per tour. Fewer visitors give up and walk.
chief.d: Sends free rangers to pins by itself — a little late, and nearest first.
chief.title: Chief Ranger
coach.1: Hi Chief! This badge is you. Tap it.
coach.10: Bigger animals push fences. Build a stronger fence here.
coach.11: That's the day! Read your report, then tap Next day.
coach.12: An egg! Move the slider to the warm middle, then tap Check.
coach.2: Drag a finger to move around the island. You can pinch to zoom, too.
coach.3: The triceratops are hungry. Tap their pin.
coach.4: Hungry animals need a Feeder. Send this Feeder.
coach.5: She picks up crates at the barn and drives over. When they are fed, tap Fed!
coach.6: Time to open! Tap the gate.
coach.7: Visitors wait for the safari tram. Tap the tram to send it out.
coach.8: Two animals are squabbling. Tap the pin, then send the Handler.
coach.9: Can these two share a paddock? Tap one animal, then the other.
coach.done: You're ready! Keep the herds fed, the fences tight and the tram full.
compare.bad: Trouble! Keep these two in different paddocks.
compare.good: Great neighbours. They will rarely squabble.
compare.ok: They can share, but expect a squabble now and then.
compare.picked: {name} picked — tap another animal to compare.
compare.second: {name} picked. Now pick a second animal.
compare.title: Compatibility
crisis.escape.b: An animal is on the path.
crisis.heat_wave.b: Crates spoil at Dune Mesa stations without a cooler; shade keeps animals calm.
crisis.rain_squall.b: Paths flood and fewer visitors come for a while.
crisis.school_trip.b: Extra visitors today — and they love the babies.
crisis.supply_late.b: Only half the morning crates; the rest come at 13:00.
err.halted: The tram waits: an animal is on the path.
err.role: That ranger can't fix this. Send the right role.
graphics.dropped: Graphics lowered to keep the game smooth. You can change it in Settings.
hatch.dig_help: A dig crew (one Handler) brings fossil shards. Two trips = one rescued egg. Costs {cp} CP.
hatch.none: No eggs right now. Send a dig crew to find fossil shards.
hatch.temp_help: Move the slider into the warm middle, then tap Check.
hatch.waiting: {name} egg waits for a free incubator.
hud.badge_info: You're the Chief Warden. Sanctuary Rating {r} — keep animals happy and visitors amazed.
hud.speed_locked: 3× speed comes with the Speed Pack.
iap.bundle.d: Edition, Ranger Pass, Speed Pack and every tram skin. No forced ads.
iap.comeback.d: Coins to get the sanctuary going again.
iap.noads.d: No more forced ads or banner. Rewards without videos (same limits).
iap.offline_plus.d: Away pay for up to 10 hours at 75 %.
iap.premium.d: No forced ads, a golden tram and starter coins.
iap.ranger_pass.d: Forever: +1 ranger per role, the Chief Ranger, +1 incubator. Includes Remove Ads.
iap.skin_tram_glacier.d: An icy blue safari tram. Looks only.
iap.skin_tram_jungle.d: A leafy green safari tram. Looks only.
iap.skin_tram_sunset.d: An orange-pink safari tram. Looks only.
iap.starter.d: Coins and one extra incubator for a fast start.
iap.storm_kit.d: Extra coins to get through a stormy day.
intro.1.b: Rescued prehistoric animals live here. You are the new Chief Warden.
intro.2.b: A hungry herd, a squabble, a loose fence. Send the right ranger team in time.
intro.3.b: Happy animals amaze visitors. Their tickets and gifts grow your sanctuary.
offline.title: While you were away
paddock.empty: No animals yet. Hatch or move one here.
paddock.needs_water: Dune animals need a water point here.
paddock.weak: This fence is too weak for a bossy animal — it wears out twice as fast.
pin.escape.d: An animal wandered onto a path. The tram waits until a Handler walks it home. Nobody is in danger.
pin.fence.d: A Fence Tech fixes it. A broken fence can let an animal wander out.
pin.flood.d: Rain flooded the path. The tram skips this stop until a Fence Tech clears it.
pin.hungry.d: The feeding station is empty. A Feeder brings crates from the barn.
pin.on_way: A ranger is on the way.
pin.sick.d: A Vet takes a look. If nobody comes, the animal rests off-exhibit until tomorrow.
pin.squabble.d: Two animals don't get along. A Handler calms them down. Better pairings mean fewer squabbles.
plan.feed_help: Crates the feed truck brings each morning. Each crate costs {cost}. Too few = hungry herds; too many spoil in the heat.
plan.live: Changes apply from the next delivery.
plan.morning: Set up the day, then open the park.
plan.tram_help: A tour takes {min} min. Up to {cap} visitors an hour.
ranger.name: {role} {n}
report.title: Day {n} report
reward.borrow_ranger.b: A ranger from the next ridge takes this pin right now.
reward.dawn_double.b: Watch a short video to get them twice.
reward.done_borrow: A borrowed ranger is on it
reward.done_scout: The dig site chart is complete
reward.done_warm: The egg is warmer — it hatches sooner
reward.free.b: Included with your ad-free pack — no video.
reward.scout_tip.b: Find out which species a dig site hides.
reward.storm_shelter.b: Every fence on the island gets fixed at once.
role.feeder.d: Brings feed crates from the barn to hungry herds.
role.handler.d: Calms squabbles, walks wandering animals home, digs for fossils.
role.tech.d: Fixes fences and clears flooded paths.
settings.guide: How to play / Replay the guide
settings.title: Settings
shop.cap: Daily pack limit reached. Come back tomorrow.
shop.restore_failed: Could not restore. Try again later.
shop.title: Shop
shop.unavailable: The store is not available right now
sp.camarasaurus.d: A towering long-neck. Needs lots of room.
sp.kentrosaurus.d: Spiky and bossy. Needs a steel fence.
sp.maiasaura.d: A gentle duckbill that looks after its young.
sp.miragaia.d: A long-necked plated grazer. Calm in the dunes.
sp.parasaurolophus.d: Its tube crest hoots. Skittish around bossy animals.
sp.protoceratops.d: Small, curious and a bit jumpy. Loves dry ground.
sp.saltasaurus.d: A sturdy long-neck from the dry plains.
sp.triceratops.d: Three horns, big heart. Calm and easy to keep.
tip.dig: Your dig crew is out. That Handler can't answer pins until they're back.
tip.dune: Dune Mesa is open! Dune animals need a water point; shade helps in a heat wave.
tip.dust: Dust storm: the tram is slower. Set the timetable to 'When full'.
tip.egg: An egg is in the incubator. Check its temperature so it warms at full speed.
tip.egg_cold: The egg cooled down halfway. Check its temperature again.
tip.escape: An animal is on the path and the tram has stopped. Send a Handler to walk it home.
tip.failed: A pin ran out of time. Hire more rangers if your teams are always busy.
tip.fence: A fence tile came loose. Send a Fence Tech before an animal wanders out.
tip.fern: Fern Valley is open! The tram tour is longer now — an extra car keeps the queue short.
tip.flood: A flooded path closes a tram stop. A Fence Tech can clear it.
tip.hatched: Babies are cute but shy. They grow up in two days.
tip.heat: Heat wave! Shade sails and coolers help at Dune Mesa.
tip.nursery: No paddock has room. Build or expand a paddock, then move the baby there.
tip.rain: Rain! Floods close tram stops until a Fence Tech clears them.
tip.report: The report shows what went well. Missed pins cost coins and calm — never animals.
tip.school: A school trip! Babies on show make the kids happiest.
tip.squabble: Squabbles come from animals that don't get along. Use the Compatibility card when you pair them.
tip.supply: The supply boat is late. Watch for hungry herds before 13:00.
tip.vet: A sick animal! Send a Vet. Red cases can't wait long.
toast.evacuation: The tram queue went home while an animal was loose.
toast.gate: The gate is open. Here come the first visitors!
toast.hatched_nursery: A baby {name} hatched — it waits in the nursery for a paddock.
upgrade.title: Upgrades
zone.cove.d: The gate, the HQ and the first two paddocks.
zone.dune.d: Hot, dry dunes. Animals here need water points and shade.
zone.fern.d: Lush forest for bigger herds. The tram loop gets longer — think about a second car.
